system.description: You spend the Floor number in minutes trying to pick the lock. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. If the lock was created by a named antagonist, this could be an INT-Opposed Skill Check instead. On Success, you pick the lock!

upgrades.description: You make no noise and leave no trace.
Each attempt takes half the time. You may alter the lock so that the key no longer works.
You don't roll with Disadvantage if you lack the proper tools.

system.limitations: Roll with Disadvantage if you do not have the proper tools, unless it's a crude lock.
